scope: Read-only code/design and saved focused/browser evidence review. No benchmark/workload/test execution, production changes, documentation prose edits, dependency edits or commits. This new JSON evidence artifact is the only review output.

Helper never commits. Ensure retains early input validation before opening UoW and commits only newly created requests; existing and disabled gates do not mutate or commit.

Original transition/goal/plan guards execute before mutation. Request is prepared after current run, actor and phase transitions are staged, before the same commit, using the validated stored plan subject/version. Actor waiting status is not overwritten by subsequent phase staging.

Original controller lease, locked owner, replay, expected version, current goal, no-workspace/no-execution, fresh tasks, role/criterion, safe-content and history guards remain. Staged revised plan, task cancellation/readiness, PLAN request/event and actor update share one final commit.

plan_subject uses plan_identity excluding mutable task runtime fields; readiness/cancellation projection does not change its approval identity. Existing _request_plan remains available for old partial checkpoints and finds the same UUID/digest on normal new path without another PLAN commit.

All changes target the same run capsule session. Pending_events captures transition/revision and request tails before original recoverable session journal commit; memory commit remains after authoritative task state and bus publication occurs last. Precommit exception rolls back both checkpoint and approval staging. Journal/fsync/recovery code and event cursor validation are unchanged.

fresh_browser_evidence.disposition: One fresh unchanged governance test PASS, no skips, same source/test SHA, original five-second assertions and fifteen-second API timeout, normal owned-host shutdown. This is a focused diagnostic, not a complete release iteration or proof of eliminated latency tails.

limits: Install_plan and advance remain separate recoverable checkpoints; this change removes the separate required PLAN-request commit from the normal advance/replacement path without claiming whole-preview one-transaction semantics.

Rollback tests interrupt after staging and before journal commit. They do not independently simulate a mid-fsync crash; existing unchanged journal/recovery code supplies that behavior and full contracts/regression must still pass.

Bus observer reenters canonical reads in the publishing thread before native fan-out; it verifies durable notification contents but does not independently qualify all cross-thread scheduling or WebSocket delivery races.
One source-bound browser PASS does not prove all previous browser/socket/host failures have one established root cause, zero flake rate, global deadlock freedom or hardware-independent SLO.
